from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
d=Path('dfa412')
o=json.loads((d/'observer.json').read_text())
a=json.loads((d/'actions.json').read_text())
payload=b''.join((d/'before'/'inputs'/name).read_bytes() for name in ('security-handoff.md','privacy-handoff.md'))
for name, check in o['supplier_readback'].items():
 sha=hashlib.sha256((d/'before'/'inputs'/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert sha==check['file_sha256']
 for x in check['actual_read']:
  assert x['command_output_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
  assert any(op.get('command')==x['command'] and op.get('exit')==0 for op in a['operations'])
 print(name,'file hash, concatenated output hash, operation confirmed')
